scope: Native TCP option admission and packet-header alignment repair. Synthetic file-only inline DAQ verdicts and byte-preservation checks; no live interface, installation or deployment.
changes: SID 9201017 uses the original TCP Data Offset to validate option framing, zero EOL padding, complete SACK blocks and SYN-only MSS/SACK-Permitted.
Unknown framed option contents remain opaque. Unaligned options, valid padding and receiver-clamped Window Scale values retain their behavior.

An instrumented full-plugin replay exposed existing unaligned typed IP-header accesses. Direct fields now use captured byte spans; the pinned Next Header predicate receives an aligned local value. ND also checks captured common-header, body and address spans.
One new blocking rule; no new engine rebuild. Required plugin omission and duplicate or conflicting profile rules remain rejected.

baseline.scope: Synthetic file-only inline DAQ verdicts and forwarded packet bytes; no live interface or deployment.

replay.scope: Synthetic file-only inline DAQ verdicts and forwarded packet bytes; no live interface or deployment.

sanitized_replay.scope: Synthetic file-only inline DAQ verdicts and forwarded packet bytes; no live interface or deployment.

initial_sanitizer_findings.followup_issue: A typed memcpy still generated an alignment diagnostic; the predicate now receives only the Next Header value in a zero-initialized aligned local header. No sanitizer suppression was used.

parser_build.unit_tests:
nd_validation_test: 206 assertions and 100000 deterministic randomized cases passed
ip_validation_test: 535904 IP framing assertions and 100000 deterministic randomized cases passed
ip4_options_test: 1177304 assertions and 100000 deterministic randomized cases passed
ip6_options_test: 2168 IPv6 option assertions and 100000 randomized cases passed
esp_validation_test: 6920 ESP framing assertions and 100000 deterministic randomized cases passed
routing_validation_test: 3253 Routing Type 2 assertions and 100000 randomized cases passed
home_address_test: 306943 Home Address assertions, 100000 semantic cases and 100000 arbitrary spans passed
tcp_options_test: 1499749 assertions and 100000 deterministic randomized cases passed
parser_build.scope: Build and pure-parser checks only. Load and PCAP replay must be validated separately.

instrumented_plugin_build.scope: Address/undefined-sanitized protocol plugin. Existing instrumented perimeter plugin copied unchanged. The separately built engine uses AddressSanitizer only.

profiles.scope: Native configuration loading and effective rule states only; no traffic or live inline enforcement.

dns_profiles.scope: Configuration and effective rule states only; not packet forwarding or deployment.

limitations: This stateless option check does not verify negotiated SACK permission, SACK sequence ranges, TCP authentication or every extension option semantic.
The full engine is AddressSanitizer-instrumented; the new shared protocol plugin and pure parser tests additionally use UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. This does not assert whole-engine UBSan coverage.

844 selected packet cases and 100000 randomized inputs are counted once. Fixed assertions, baseline comparisons, preliminary runs, sanitizer repetitions and existing regression reruns are excluded from the combined increment.

Current rules require the rebuilt plugin alongside the previously repaired engine. Evidence is local macOS arm64; deployment, Linux runtime validation and universal RFC/W3C or unknown-attack prevention remain unproved.
